messages:
ravi: Bringing up monitoring pipeline for the new ap-south-3 GPU pool. Need a concise provisioning & validation checklist for logs / metrics / traces + dashboards + alert templates. Who can own?
elaine: I can own dashboards + alert templates. Quick items we need: deploy agents, Prometheus, Grafana, OTEL collector, fluentd/forwarder, index lifecycle, alert runbooks.
sam: I'll take agent rollout (node exporter + cadvisor + gpu exporter) and Prometheus scraping. What's our retention budget for hot logs?
lina: For traces: use head-based sampling in OTEL. Recommend 1% for inference pods, 10-20% for infra services. That cuts cost a lot.
ops-bot: Deploy job queued: namespace=monitoring, charts=[prometheus-operator,grafana,otel-collector,fluentd]. CI pipeline id=ci/mon-482.
ravi: Smoke test targets: metrics: node_gpu_util, pod_gpu_mem_free, pod_cpu, pod_network_tx_err. Logs: OOMKill, docker restarts, kernel network drops. Traces: full request path for model-serving pods.
sam: On rollout, run these quick commands: ```kubectl get pods -n monitoring``` ```kubectl port-forward svc/grafana -n monitoring 3000:80``` ```curl -sS http://localhost:3000/api/health``` Also verify prometheus targets: ```kubectl exec -n monitoring deploy/prometheus -c prometheus -- curl -s localhost:9090/-/targets```
elaine: Alert templates (draft): - GPU_HIGH: expr=node_gpu_util > 0.92 for 5m -> severity=critical, runbook link - OOM_RATE: increase in container_oom_kill_count by >1/min -> severity=high - PROM_REMOTE_FAIL: prometheus_remote_storage_success_rate < 0.99 for 10m -> severity=warning - LOG_INGEST_LAG: fluentd_forwarder_lag_seconds > 30s -> severity=warning
lina: Index lifecycle suggestion: logs_hot=7d, warm=30d, cold=365d for GPU clusters. Metrics: keep 90d at full resolution then downsample to 1m/5m for longer retention. Traces: keep spans 30d full, 365d sampled indices.
sam: Cost note: hot storage for logs is the largest driver. If we overprovision hot retention to 30d we'll blow the budget. Start conservative and iterate.
ops-bot: Agent rollout: fluentd configmap applied, otel-collector config uploaded, prometheus scrapeconfigs updated. Job status: fluentd=ok, otel=ok, prometheus=deploying.
ravi: Run these validation checks after rollout: 1) Grafana dashboards show gpu_util panel population 2) Prometheus shows targets UP 3) Fluentd metrics show active forwarders 4) Trace spans available in Jaeger/OTEL backend 5) Alert test fires for a simulated GPU burn
sam: I'll kick a 4-hour burn-in that pushes 20% extra synthetic GPU utilization across a test node set. Will watch for alert noise and index growth.
elaine: I'll prepare dashboard links and an alert playbook stub. Add labels to logs: cluster, region, node_role. We need node_role to filter infra vs model-serving.
sam: Burn-in started. Quick note: found missing label in fluentd pipeline: 'node_role' not being attached for kube-system logs. Patching now.
ops-bot: Patch applied to fluentd configmap; rolling restart fluentd-daemonset in progress.
sam: Burn-in finished (4h). Results: - GPU_HIGH alert fired once during test - Dashboards populated and panels render - One alert flapped due to scrape timeout (prometheus->node exporter) — adding 30s buffer to rule. - Log index growth within expected (estimated +12% over baseline).avi: Good. Lina, can you add the trace-sampling config to the OTEL collector so we preserve perf signals but control cost?
lina: Done. Sampling rules: service.model-serving rate=0.01, service.control-plane rate=0.2. Config pushed to monitoring/otel-collector-configmap v1.2.
elaine: Final steps: - upload runbook (play-by-play + commands) - create dashboard folder in Grafana and add panels - schedule a handoff with oncall - attach alert runbooks to each alert
ravi: Scheduled handoff: tomorrow 10:00 UTC. @oncall-bot please add to rotation and ping oncall channel at 09:50 UTC.
oncall-bot: Rotation updated: monitoring-handoff scheduled, reminder set for 09:50 UTC.
elaine: Uploaded runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/monitoring/ap-south-3 (private link). Covered checklist, smoke logs, alert thresholds, rollbacks.
sam: Leaving a final note: remember to enable Prometheus remote_write to our long-term storage before increasing scrape retention. Also recommend enforcing label cardinality limits on logs to avoid index explosion.
ravi: Thanks everyone — handoff complete after tomorrow's session, but for now we have a validated baseline. Adding this thread to infra-runbooks as the commissioning chat log.
